sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, sum(s.SalesAmount) as total_sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName ORDER BY total_sales DESC
